### Install R, Rstudio, and R packages

- Install *R* and *Rstudio*: install R and Rstudio on your personal laptop! For a guide, see for example [this tutorial](https://moderndive.com/v2/getting-started.html) (Sections 1.1-1.3) and get familiar with Rstudio interface. If you prefer a video tutorial, check it [here](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLRPB0ZzEYegOZivdelOuEn-R-XUN-DOjd).
`in
- In R console, install useful *packages*, with the `install.packages()` command. Run 

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE
#| eval: FALSE
install.packages("tidyverse")
```
